review: Exact encrypted workflow domain/scope matches production application; only eligible confirmed withdraw/withdraw-bok records admitted before constructing RPC client. Private proving payload is not returned. Guard/account identity and existing browser lock protect custody.

Public-only facade exposes canonical public data methods, no wallet/PXE/prover construction or L2 send. getContract targets configured board/Bok contracts, not human account. Existing native network check, artifact-derived class/address, current anchored portal storage, exact L1 portal runtime/dependency checks and both anchor rechecks remain.

Existing withdrawal driver verifies original successful L2 receipt/effect and exact withdrawal message leaf/witness, original depositor, chain, portal and amount. Unsettled Outbox blocks preflight. Existing encrypted Ethereum journal preserves unknown-outcome reconciliation and explicit same-nonce review; no automatic replay.

Explicit refund entry and refundOnly publication bypass private session creation. Recovery import retains custody, disables account creation in refundOnly view, and invokes only public recovery. Existing encrypted workflow is never overwritten by this composition.

Validated publicRefundRpcUrl adds only explicit origin to existing CSP; HTTPS required except native local chain. Existing private query/prover metadata remains validated and ordinary mode unchanged. Runtime assets remain authenticated; this still loads SDK assets but does not initialize private PXE/proving.
Provider destroyed on constructor failure/close; busy lock prevents closing during owned refund operation. Driver retains its existing pending-call drain and mutation fences.

limits: Focused checks use genuine encrypted journals/SDK message hashing with explicitly labelled RPC/contract/browser doubles. No actual public endpoint/refund/wallet transaction accepted by this review.
Confirmed original L2 exit must remain recoverable in imported workflow; missing or unconfirmed records deliberately fail rather than create another exit.
Publication must rebuild normal wallet runtime and bind actual public RPC endpoint/current scope; no SDK rebuild or service qualification required by this source review.
